deploy.preDeployCommand: sh -c 'export DB_CONNECTION=${DB_CONNECTION:-mysql}; export DB_HOST=${DB_HOST:-$MYSQLHOST}; export DB_PORT=${DB_PORT:-$MYSQLPORT}; export DB_DATABASE=${DB_DATABASE:-$MYSQLDATABASE}; export DB_USERNAME=${DB_USERNAME:-$MYSQLUSER}; export DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-$MYSQLPASSWORD}; export CACHE_STORE=${CACHE_STORE:-file}; export QUEUE_CONNECTION=${QUEUE_CONNECTION:-sync}; php artisan migrate --force'
